## Wakt 1.0.6

### DNS log
Tap the "Website filter" card on the App/Site tab to open a live log of every DNS query the filter handled: domain, record type, result (BLOCKED, FORWARDED, CACHED, TIMEOUT), the app that asked, and the DNS server it addressed. The header shows the upstream servers and the addresses being intercepted. "Copy" puts the whole log on the clipboard for sharing, "Clear" resets it.

### Why it exists
If a blocked site still loads, the log shows whether its name was ever asked through system DNS. A missing name means the app resolved it some other way (its own DNS over HTTPS, a cached address, or a connection that was already open).
